input.summary: Convert the mutual no-hire into a narrow non-solicit with a general-advertising carve-out
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a no-hire covering all of the other party's employees. We have narrowed Section 19 to a non-solicit of personnel directly involved in the services and added the usual general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs; the mutual 12-month duration is unchanged.

ops.oldText: both parties agree not to hire or allow its respective affiliates to hire any employee of the other party, or any person who was an employee of the other party during the previous six months and who was directly involved in the provision of services under this Agreement.
ops.newText: both parties agree not to solicit for employment, or allow their respective affiliates to solicit for employment, any employee of the other party who is or was directly involved in the provision of services under this Agreement, provided that nothing in this Section shall restrict either party or its affiliates from hiring any person who responds to a general advertisement or other solicitation not specifically targeted at the other party's personnel, or who approaches that party on an unsolicited basis.

input.summary: Add affiliate/successor assignment carve-out for Sparkling and a reasonableness standard
input.comment: [Playbook] A blanket bar on assignment with no M&A carve-out is not something we can accept. We have added Sparkling's right to assign to an affiliate or successor without consent, made consent otherwise subject to a reasonableness standard, and confirmed that a change of control gives Garman no termination or re-pricing right.

ops.oldText: (d) Neither party may assign this Agreement or any rights and obligations under this Agreement to any third party without the written consent of the other party.
ops.newText: (d) Neither party may assign this Agreement or any rights and obligations under this Agreement to any third party without the written consent of the other party, which shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed; provided that Sparkling may assign this Agreement, without consent, to an affiliate or to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets, and no change of control of Sparkling shall entitle Garman to terminate, suspend or re-price this Agreement.

ops.oldText: (c) not assign this Agreement or transfer, lease, export or grant a sublicence of the Work to any Person, except as and when authorized to do so by Garman in writing;
ops.newText: (c) not transfer, lease, export or grant a sublicence of the Work to any Person, except as and when authorized to do so by Garman in writing or as permitted by Section 20(d);
